result.description: A fictional ultra-high-capacity tape archive cartridge designed for long-term cold storage in broadcast vaults and research archives. NOVA LILT emphasizes write-once preservation, low media cost per terabyte, and shelf-stable retention for offline compliance workflows. It is not intended for gaming, workstation graphics, or consumer external backup use. Compatible with hypothetical L-series archival decks, the cartridge is described as featuring serpentine recording, cartridge-level encryption sealing, and a 30-year nominal retention target under controlled conditions.
